/* clone-only: behaviour helpers, no visual or content change */
.mobile-submenu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 6px;background:#f6f8fc}
.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}

/* clone-only: behaviour helpers, no visual or content change */
.mobile-submenu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 6px;background:#f6f8fc}
.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}

css:
:root{
  --hero:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
  --blue:#016edc; --blue-dark:#014284; --ink:#1c293f; --deep:#00334e;
  --amber:#ffa800; --amber-dark:#e07a00;
  --muted:#5b6470; --light:#f0f0fa; --soft:#f5f5f5; --line:#e5e7eb; --white:#ffffff;
  --r-sm:16px; --r-md:30px; --r-pill:60px;
  --shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(28,41,63,.10);
  --shadow-sm:0 8px 24px rgba(28,41,63,.08);
  --max:1200px;
  --font:"Fustat",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:120px;}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);line-height:1.6;font-size:17px;font-weight:400;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 .5em;}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.5rem);}
h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;}
p{margin:0 0 1rem;}
a{color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}
a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
.wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
.section{padding:72px 0;}
.section--tight{padding:52px 0;}
.eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.lead{font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;}
.center{text-align:center;}
.center .lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:15px 28px;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,background .15s ease;text-decoration:none;}
.btn:hover{text-decoration:none;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-primary{background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,168,0,.35);}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--amber-dark);color:#fff;}
.btn-blue{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-blue:hover{background:var(--blue-dark);color:#fff;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;}
.btn-outline{background:#fff;color:var(--blue-dark);border-color:var(--line);}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue-dark);}

/* Skip link + focus */
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:0 0 12px 0;z-index:1200;}
.skip:focus{left:0;}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px;}

/* Utility bar */
.util{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:.86rem;}
.util .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:9px;padding-bottom:9px;}
.util a{color:#fff;font-weight:600;}
.util .util-left{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 20px;align-items:center;}
.util i{color:var(--amber);margin-right:6px;}
.util .promo{background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);}

/* Header */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(28,41,63,.05);}
.site-header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px;}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.brand img{height:54px;width:auto;}
.brand .brand-name{font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.1;}
.brand .brand-name span{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px 3px;flex:1;}
.nav a{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;}
.nav a:hover{background:var(--light);color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}
.header-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.header-cta .phone{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue-dark);white-space:nowrap;}
.header-cta .phone i{color:var(--amber);}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:12px;width:46px;height:44px;font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer;}

/* Hero */
.hero{position:relative;background-color:#013a76;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(2,32,66,.93) 0%,rgba(2,40,82,.80) 45%,rgba(1,66,132,.42) 100%),var(--hero);background-size:cover;background-position:center right;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(1000px 460px at 84% -10%,rgba(255,168,0,.12),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;padding-top:70px;padding-bottom:78px;}
.hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.4rem);margin-bottom:.35em;}
.hero .hero-sub{font-size:1.2rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:1.4rem;}
.hero .hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:1.6rem;}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;}
.chips li i{color:var(--amber);}

.quote-card h2{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:.15em;}

.field{margin-bottom:12px;}
.field label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:5px;}

.field textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical;}

.quote-card .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:4px;}

.stats .stat i{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:8px;display:block;}
.stats .stat strong{display:block;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;}
.stats .stat span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:.92rem;}

.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;}

.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem;margin-bottom:.9rem;}

.on-light{background:var(--light);}
.on-soft{background:var(--soft);}

.aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
.aud .card{border-top:5px solid var(--amber);}

/* Why choose list */
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px 34px;}
.why .item{display:flex;gap:16px;}
.why .item i{flex:0 0 auto;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(1,110,220,.10);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.15rem;}
.why .item h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:.25em;}
.why .item p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;margin:0;}

.footer-contact{padding:0;margin:14px 0 0;}

.site-footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:16px;}

.footer-col li{margin-bottom:9px;font-size:.95rem;}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;}
.socials a{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--blue);}

@media (max-width:1024px){
  .nav{display:none;}
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;}

  .why{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}

  .grid-3,.grid-2,.reviews,.aud,.ba-grid,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;}

  .header-cta .phone span{display:none;}
  .util .util-left .hide-sm{display:none;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

.on-soft{background:var(--soft);}

/* Audience blocks */
.aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
.aud .card{border-top:5px solid var(--amber);}

/* Why choose list */
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px 34px;}
.why .item{display:flex;gap:16px;}
.why .item i{flex:0 0 auto;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(1,110,220,.10);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.15rem;}
.why .item h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:.25em;}
.why .item p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;margin:0;}

/* Process */
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;counter-reset:step;}
.step{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:26px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.step .num{counter-increment:step;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
.step .num::before{content:counter(step);}
.step h3{font-size:1.1rem;}
.step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin:0;}

/* Image placeholder */
.ph{position:relative;border:2px dashed #b9c6dd;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#eef3fb,#eef3fb 14px,#e6edf8 14px,#e6edf8 28px);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#4a5a76;padding:26px;min-height:230px;}
.ph .ph-inner{max-width:340px;}
.ph i{font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:10px;}
.ph b{display:block;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue-dark);}
.ph small{display:block;color:#5a6a86;font-size:.82rem;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4;}
.ba-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;}

/* Testimonials */
.reviews{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
.review{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.review .stars{color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1rem;}
.review p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);}
.review .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.review .who .av{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.95rem;}
.review .who b{display:block;font-size:.96rem;}
.review .who span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.review .who span i{color:#4285F4;}

/* Areas */
.area-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;}
.area-links a{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:9px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-size:.92rem;}
.area-links a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}

/* CTA band */
.cta-band{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--blue-dark),var(--blue));color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:46px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.cta-band h2{color:#fff;margin-bottom:.2em;}
.cta-band p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);margin:0;max-width:52ch;}
.cta-band .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}

/* FAQ */
.faq{max-width:840px;margin:0 auto;}
.faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 22px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;padding:16px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.faq summary i{color:var(--blue);transition:transform .2s ease;flex:0 0 auto;}
.faq details[open] summary i{transform:rotate(45deg);}
.faq details p{color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:16px;margin:0;}

/* Blog */
.blog-band{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:22px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}

/* Footer */
.site-footer{background:var(--ink);color:#cfd6e2;padding:60px 0 26px;}
.site-footer a{color:#cfd6e2;}
.site-footer a:hover{color:#fff;}
.footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:34px;padding-bottom:34px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);}
.footer-brand img{height:56px;width:auto;margin-bottom:14px;background:#fff;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;}
.footer-brand p{color:#a9b3c4;font-size:.95rem;max-width:34ch;}
.footer-contact li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;list-style:none;font-size:.95rem;}
.footer-contact{padding:0;margin:14px 0 0;}
.footer-contact i{color:var(--amber);margin-top:3px;}
.site-footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:16px;}
.footer-col ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.footer-col li{margin-bottom:9px;font-size:.95rem;}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;}
.socials a{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--blue);}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 24px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:22px;font-size:.88rem;color:#9aa5b8;}
.footer-bottom .legal a{margin-left:18px;}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .nav{display:none;}
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;}
  .hero{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,32,66,.90),rgba(1,50,100,.85) 55%,rgba(1,66,132,.80)),var(--hero);background-position:center;}
  .stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:26px;}
  .grid-3,.reviews,.aud{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .why{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .mobile-open .nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:flex-start;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 24px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);gap:2px;max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;}
  .mobile-open .nav a{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:10px;}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .section{padding:52px 0;}
  .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .grid-3,.grid-2,.reviews,.aud,.ba-grid,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .cta-band{padding:32px 24px;}
  .header-cta .phone span{display:none;}
  .util .util-left .hide-sm{display:none;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

/* clone-only: behaviour helpers, no visual or content change */
.mobile-submenu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 6px;background:#f6f8fc}
.mobile-submenu a{padding-left:40px;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}
.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}

css:
:root{
  --hero:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
  --blue:#016edc; --blue-dark:#014284; --ink:#1c293f; --deep:#00334e;
  --amber:#ffa800; --amber-dark:#e07a00;
  --muted:#5b6470; --light:#f0f0fa; --soft:#f5f5f5; --line:#e5e7eb; --white:#ffffff;
  --r-sm:16px; --r-md:30px; --r-pill:60px;
  --shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(28,41,63,.10);
  --shadow-sm:0 8px 24px rgba(28,41,63,.08);
  --max:1200px;
  --font:"Fustat",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:120px;}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);line-height:1.6;font-size:17px;font-weight:400;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 .5em;}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.4vw,2.5rem);}
h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;}
p{margin:0 0 1rem;}
a{color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}
a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
.wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
.section{padding:72px 0;}
.section--tight{padding:52px 0;}
.eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.lead{font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;}
.center{text-align:center;}
.center .lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--font);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:15px 28px;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,background .15s ease;text-decoration:none;}
.btn:hover{text-decoration:none;transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-primary{background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,168,0,.35);}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--amber-dark);color:#fff;}
.btn-blue{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-blue:hover{background:var(--blue-dark);color:#fff;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;}
.btn-outline{background:#fff;color:var(--blue-dark);border-color:var(--line);}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue-dark);}

/* Skip link + focus */
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:0 0 12px 0;z-index:1200;}
.skip:focus{left:0;}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--amber);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px;}

/* Utility bar */
.util{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:.86rem;}
.util .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:9px;padding-bottom:9px;}
.util a{color:#fff;font-weight:600;}
.util .util-left{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 20px;align-items:center;}
.util i{color:var(--amber);margin-right:6px;}
.util .promo{background:var(--amber);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);}

/* Header */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(28,41,63,.05);}
.site-header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding-top:12px;padding-bottom:12px;}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.brand img{height:54px;width:auto;}
.brand .brand-name{font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.1;}
.brand .brand-name span{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px 3px;flex:1;}
.nav a{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:10px;white-space:nowrap;}
.nav a:hover{background:var(--light);color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}
.header-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
.header-cta .phone{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue-dark);white-space:nowrap;}
.header-cta .phone i{color:var(--amber);}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:12px;width:46px;height:44px;font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer;}

/* Hero */
.hero{position:relative;background-color:#013a76;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(2,32,66,.93) 0%,rgba(2,40,82,.80) 45%,rgba(1,66,132,.42) 100%),var(--hero);background-size:cover;background-position:center right;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(1000px 460px at 84% -10%,rgba(255,168,0,.12),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;padding-top:70px;padding-bottom:78px;}
.hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,3.4rem);margin-bottom:.35em;}
.hero .hero-sub{font-size:1.2rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:1.4rem;}
.hero .hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:1.6rem;}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;}
.chips li i{color:var(--amber);}

/* Hero form */
.quote-card{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r-sm);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:26px;}
.quote-card h2{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:.15em;}
.quote-card .muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
.field{margin-bottom:12px;}
.field label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;margin-bottom:5px;}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.98rem;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--blue);}
.field textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical;}
.form-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;}
.quote-card .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:4px;}

/* Trust stats */
.stats{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;}
.stats .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;padding-top:30px;padding-bottom:30px;text-align:center;}
.stats .stat i{font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:8px;display:block;}
.stats .stat strong{display:block;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;}
.stats .stat span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:.92rem;}

/* Generic grid + cards */
.grid{display:grid;gap:24px;}
.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;height:100%;}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:#cfe0fb;}
.card .ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--light);color:var(--blue);font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:14px;}
.card h3{margin-bottom:.4em;}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem;margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.card .go{font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-dark);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
.card .go i{transition:transform .15s ease;}
.card:hover .go i{transform:translateX(4px);}

.on-blue{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--blue-dark),var(--blue));color:#fff;}
.on-blue h2,.on-blue h3{color:#fff;}
.on-light{background:var(--light);}
.on-soft{background:var(--soft);}

/* Audience blocks */
.aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
.aud .card{border-top:5px solid var(--amber);}

/* Why choose list */
.why{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:22px 34px;}
.why .item{display:flex;gap:16px;}
.why .item i{flex:0 0 auto;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(1,110,220,.10);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.15rem;}
.why .item h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:.25em;}
.why .item p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;margin:0;}

/* Process */
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;counter-reset:step;}
.step{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:26px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}

.step h3{font-size:1.1rem;}
.step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin:0;}

/* Image placeholder */

.ph .ph-inner{max-width:340px;}

.ph b{display:block;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue-dark);}
.ph small{display:block;color:#5a6a86;font-size:.82rem;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4;}

/* Testimonials */

.review .stars{color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1rem;}
.review p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink);}

.faq details p{color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:16px;margin:0;}

.footer-brand img{height:56px;width:auto;margin-bottom:14px;background:#fff;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;}

.footer-contact{padding:0;margin:14px 0 0;}
.footer-contact i{color:var(--amber);margin-top:3px;}
.site-footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:16px;}

.footer-col li{margin-bottom:9px;font-size:.95rem;}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;}
.socials a{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--blue);}

.footer-bottom .legal a{margin-left:18px;}

@media (max-width:1024px){

  .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;}

  .util .util-left .hide-sm{display:none;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

/* Areas */

.area-links a{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:9px 16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);font-size:.92rem;}
.area-links a:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue-dark);text-decoration:none;}

/* CTA band */
.cta-band{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--blue-dark),var(--blue));color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:46px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.cta-band h2{color:#fff;margin-bottom:.2em;}
.cta-band p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);margin:0;max-width:52ch;}
.cta-band .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}

/* FAQ */
.faq{max-width:840px;margin:0 auto;}
.faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 22px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;padding:16px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.faq summary i{color:var(--blue);transition:transform .2s ease;flex:0 0 auto;}
.faq details[open] summary i{transform:rotate(45deg);}
.faq details p{color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:16px;margin:0;}

/* Blog */
.blog-band{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:22px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}

/* Footer */
.site-footer{background:var(--ink);color:#cfd6e2;padding:60px 0 26px;}
.site-footer a{color:#cfd6e2;}
.site-footer a:hover{color:#fff;}
.footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:34px;padding-bottom:34px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);}
.footer-brand img{height:56px;width:auto;margin-bottom:14px;background:#fff;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;}
.footer-brand p{color:#a9b3c4;font-size:.95rem;max-width:34ch;}
.footer-contact li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;list-style:none;font-size:.95rem;}
.footer-contact{padding:0;margin:14px 0 0;}
.footer-contact i{color:var(--amber);margin-top:3px;}
.site-footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:16px;}
.footer-col ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;}
.footer-col li{margin-bottom:9px;font-size:.95rem;}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px;}
.socials a{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--blue);}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 24px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:22px;font-size:.88rem;color:#9aa5b8;}
.footer-bottom .legal a{margin-left:18px;}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .nav{display:none;}
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;}
  .hero{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,32,66,.90),rgba(1,50,100,.85) 55%,rgba(1,66,132,.80)),var(--hero);background-position:center;}
  .stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:26px;}
  .grid-3,.reviews,.aud{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .why{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .mobile-open .nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:flex-start;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 24px 18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);gap:2px;max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;}
  .mobile-open .nav a{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:10px;}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .section{padding:52px 0;}
  .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .grid-3,.grid-2,.reviews,.aud,.ba-grid,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .cta-band{padding:32px 24px;}
  .header-cta .phone span{display:none;}
  .util .util-left .hide-sm{display:none;}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}
